facts.fact: 圣诞礼盒：卫衣+他的古龙水——他在用气味挽留 slipping away 的她。
facts.anchor: He sent me a box not too long ago.

facts.fact: FaceTime 睡照日常：他保留通话看她睡；她有时装睡试探他的反应。
facts.anchor: Even when I sleep, he keeps the call going, and he’ll watch me.

facts.fact: 惊喜空降：他就在 Good Vintage 店里——她简直不敢相信生活对她这么好。
facts.anchor: “I’m definitely not kidding. Are you coming or what?”

facts.fact: 四个月来第一次见面：他剃了平头（她还是喜欢他的长卷发）。
facts.anchor: in person with all of his hair buzzed off.

facts.fact: 车内 New City Burgers + 室友 Stilinski（总偷带酒进营房、听他念叨她）。
乐高项链揭晓：白+紫两块一扣即成心形——a piece of my heart。
facts.anchor: places them on top of one another. As they connect, it creates a heart.

facts.fact: 她拒绝告别吻：因为你要再走一次，不想重尝第一次的痛。
facts.anchor: I don’t want to feel the same pain I did the first time.

facts.fact: 他的誓言：哪怕有点傻也要 hope——try until I die，绝不让你从指缝溜走。
facts.anchor: I’m not letting you slip through my fingers.

facts.fact: 他已关门说我爱你——她喊 Wait 要求最后一吻，他折返照办。
facts.anchor: He stares at me for half a second before climbing back into the car

facts.fact: 她心里的回话（始终没说出口）：我也爱你。对不起，Sean。
facts.anchor: I love you too. I’m sorry, Sean.
